caseNameFull: Edelman, Director, Department of Public Aid of Illinois v. Townsend

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. N. D. Ill. Motions of appellees Alexander *915and Hucher for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded so that District Court may enter a fresh judgment from which a timely appeal may be taken to the Court of Appeals.
